QuestInfo.name: [Legends] 4th Mission - Finding Shiny Light Bulbs
QuestInfo.0: Complete Gaga's tasks so you can join in the Legends Awards.
QuestInfo.1: Collect 30 Shiny Light Bulbs from normal monsters and bring them to Gaga.
QuestInfo.2: You brought the Shiny Light Bulbs to Gaga. If you complete this task 10 times, you can move on to the next task.
